message.reasoning_content: need to determine the crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant intentionally used his car to block and collide with victim's car, causing damage to vehicle (value 5684 yuan). No death or serious injury. The act is "破坏交通工具" (damage to motor vehicle) under Article 133 of Criminal Law? Actually Article 133: "破坏交通工具罪" – destroying or damaging motor vehicles, aircraft, ships, etc, causing safety hazards. If the damage is minor and no serious consequences, may be punishable under Article 133, with a term up to 3 years or criminal detention. Also could be "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property) under Article 275, but that applies to property not specifically vehicles? Usually vehicle damage is covered by Article 133 (破坏交通工具罪) if it endangers safety. The prosecution says "破坏他人车辆，足以使汽车发生倾覆、毁坏危险，危害公共安全，尚未造成严重后果". That matches Article 133. So the crime is "破坏交通工具罪". Provide answer format: [罪名]破坏交通工具罪<eoa>.
